[size=3][b]Description[/b]
This is an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description]Alternative Textures[/url] content pack for the Farmhouse and Cabin building exteriors. The Farmhouse [size=3][size=3]has been tagged with "LemonEX" and the Cabins have been tagged with "Sonreirblah", and the recolours have been tagged with "leifstump", "DaisyNeko" and "Earthy", to make them easier to find with AT's search feature.[/size][/size]
